title: 50 Lakh SIPs Cancelled in One Month — AMFI Oct 2026 Data #Shorts
description:
AMFI October 2026 data reveals a shocking truth: 50.40 lakh SIP accounts were terminated — more than the 45.28 lakh new SIPs registered. Stoppage ratio hit 116.66%, the first time ever above 100%. Yet ₹32,160 crore still flowed in.

What caused the spike? Auto-cancellations from failed ECS mandates, profit-booking after the Sensex rally, and FPI sell-off anxiety.

Is your SIP still active? Check your app. 3 failed debits = auto-stop.
